content.short: Pencils Protocol is the premier DeFi hub on Scroll, featuring yield optimization, staking, and a native launchpad.
content.description: Pencils Protocol is the definitive decentralized finance gateway and yield powerhouse built natively for the Scroll ZK-rollup ecosystem. Formerly PenPad, the platform provides a suite of DeFi services, including automated vaults for leveraged yield farming and secure asset staking. Pencils Protocol serves as a primary hub for project bootstrapping through its integrated launchpad, enabling new protocols to build initial liquidity transparently. Powered by the $DAPP token, it features a robust governance model that delivers a seamless user experience with Ethereum-grade security.
